statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nasdaq weakness persists, but the latest evidence shows some midday retracement rather than a confirmed no-retracement path.
recommendation: Current policy mapping is WATCH; the key escalation condition is renewed persistent Nasdaq extension with shallow or failed retracements alongside aligned yields, oil and breadth.
headline: Nasdaq remains under pressure, but midday retracement keeps Tail below the block threshold
body: At 12:15 p.m. ET Reuters had the Nasdaq Composite down 0.92%, the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.70%, oil up about 2.1%, and Nasdaq decliners ahead by roughly 2-to-1. More recent live coverage showed the Nasdaq closer to 0.7% lower, indicating some retracement. Fresh Finviz context showed 7 of 8 tracked megacaps lower and mixed semiconductor breadth. Cross-asset Stress is extreme, but detailed failed-retracement NQ structure is not independently verified.
